listed_quote.quote: The Target Fund currently operates as a mutual fund.

announcement.quote: At a meeting held on February 22-23, 2023, the Matthews Asia Funds Board of Trustees approved the reorganization (the “Reorganization”) of the Matthews Korea Fund into the Matthews Korea Active ETF on or around July 14, 2023

deals.notes: Target is an open-end mutual fund (series of the trust) reorganized into an ETF; not a listed closed-end pair. The episode CIK 923184 is the trust (Matthews International Funds), which is the filer; the funds' own CIKs are not in the headers.

problems: Seq 13 (2025-01-27, 425) and the 2024 N-14 filings concern a later proposal involving Matthews Asian Growth and Income Fund and Matthews Emerging Markets Equity Fund; the excerpts do not show who is target or acquirer, or whether either is listed, so no deal is recorded for them.
